name: terminal-replica
description: Reproduce YOUR real terminal and CLI agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI) faithfully in any generated graphic, GIF, or video frame. Use whenever an asset shows a terminal, an agent transcript, a statusline, or a CLI banner. Capture your actual theme, font, prompt and statusline first, and never invent a generic "hacker terminal" look.

findings.excerpt: - Do not fake it from memory. If an asset needs it, install it in a scratch environment (`npm i -g @google/gemini-cli`), run it and screenshot it.
